goal: Play like a new player for the first few minutes: get your plot (walk onto a CLAIM gate or wait for auto-claim), watch cash come in, walk onto the glowing green Dropper 2 buy pad as soon as you can afford it, keep buying the next pads as they appear and watch your plot grow, open the SHOP with the SHOP button and buy upgrades there, press REBIRTH once you can afford it, look at the TOP TYCOONS board in the plaza, and report anything confusing, broken or unfair
summary: The playtester started with the shop already open. It bought Dropper 2 and Dropper 3 from the pads, bought Speed 1 and Silver Ore in the shop, and pressed REBIRTH several times. A rebirth went through at step 3, and nine others were denied. It ended the session without ever looking at the TOP TYCOONS board, and the early plot claim and first cash income are not visible in the trace. There were no server errors, and the only game issue is stale pad labels.

bugs.title: Rebirth went through while the button showed less than 100%
bugs.evidence: At step 3 the button read 'REBIRTH $10.0K (92%)' and the press was accepted. The following observation shows the post-rebirth state (Ore: Bronze, Slots 1, Cash x1), and step 4 shows the button reset to 1%. Either the percentage on the button is stale, or the cost check lets players rebirth before they have $10K. The cause could not be determined from the trace.

bugs.title: Bought upgrade pads still show their buy label and price
bugs.evidence: After Dropper 2 and Speed 1 were bought (shop cards read 'Owned', slots went 1 to 2), UpgradePad_dropper2 still lists 'Dropper 2 | $10' and UpgradePad_speed1 'Speed 1 | $22'. The HUD still shows '$10' and '$22' price text (steps 6-9).

bugs.title: Dropper 3 pad still shows its price after purchase
bugs.evidence: After step 15 the shop card reads 'Owned' and slots went from 2 to 3. The pad is still labelled 'Dropper 3 | $150' (CanTouch=false) and the HUD still shows stale '$10' and '$22' price text (steps 16-18). A new player could think the purchase did not register.

bugs.title: Pressing 'Owned' on shop cards gives no visible feedback
bugs.evidence: The Owned button on Card_dropper2 was pressed at steps 1, 7, 12 and 17. Each press reported 'button fired', but the trace shows no confirmation message or state change.
